name: Flight School
completeToast: Flight school complete. Try not to embarrass us.

steps.title: THROTTLE
steps.text: Arena Command here. Your engines are idle and it is embarrassing. Push the lever up.
steps.hint: Drag the throttle on the right — or hold W.

steps.title: STEERING
steps.text: Better. Now fly it. Swing that nose around and look at some space.
steps.hint: Drag with the RIGHT mouse button — or one finger anywhere on the view.

steps.title: GUNS
steps.text: Tap a WEAPON to fire it. The ring around the button is its cooldown — hold the button down and the rack fires again the instant that ring clears.
steps.hint: Tap the weapon button (or SPACE), then hold it and watch the ring cycle.

steps.title: ENERGY
steps.text: Tap the SHIELD. Its ring is ENERGY — it drains while the shield is up and refills while it is down. Nothing out here is free.

steps.title: TARGET LOCK
steps.text: Salvage hulk on your nose. Keep it inside the reticle until the ring closes: LOCKED.
steps.hint: Missiles will not launch without a lock — they flash NO LOCK at you instead.

steps.title: WEAPONS FREE
steps.text: It is a hulk, not a friend. Take it apart — and mind your cooldowns while you do it.

steps.title: CONTACT
steps.text: Training drone inbound, live guns. Ours, so it is a bad shot. Same drill: lock it, close it, kill it.

steps.title: SPLASH
steps.text: Confirmed kill. You are now officially dangerous. Bring it home.

steps.title: THE HANGAR
steps.text: That ship is a rental until you touch it. Open the HANGAR.

steps.title: FITTING
steps.text: Every socket is a decision. Pick a slot and put something in it — buy it if you have to. The first one is on us.
steps.hint: Tap a slot, then EQUIP. Watch the power bar move.

steps.title: THE SHOP
steps.text: Last stop. HULLS change how you fly. MODULES change what you do. PAINTS change absolutely nothing, and you will buy one anyway.
steps.hint: Dismissed, pilot. The arena is that way.
